misprints.note: Printed as one word with the gm abbreviation; kept.
There is no full stop after öfr.
In Förbannelse a 'b)' follows '1) eg.' with no 'a)' before it; kept as printed.
Acute instead of grave on the article inside a phrase.
Comma for full stop in both places.
An article 'ὁ.' ends the list of adjectives under Föraktare; kept.

uncertain.note: The n looks like a u ('smusättningar'), probably a broken or turned n. Written as smnsättningar.
In '(äfv. εἰ, ὡς, ὅτι)' the mark above ω may be a rough breathing plus a grave (ὣς). Read as ὡς.
There may be a small space after the hyphen ('- τρέχειν'). Written without one.
